title: A conversation that continues
description: Practice your own lines and come back to recurring difficulties in later conversations.

blocks.text: A person wants to discuss a work meeting or a trip but gets stuck when the answer is open-ended. This idea is short conversations linked to each other: a difficulty from today’s conversation comes back tomorrow in a new situation.

quote.text: What good is a streak on the popular apps, I can’t actually speak. After trying the ones that are most popular on TikTok and IG, I did the trial with. Praktika and fell in love. Real conversations, no bull.

blocks.text: Carry the topic into the next conversation

After the conversation the person picks one moment to go over: their recording, the text that was heard and a possible way to put it. The next conversation brings a similar task with different words. The partner accepts a range of answers and can ask again if the meaning isn’t clear.

The thing to test first is a single series of conversations with people who already have the vocabulary. If a new session repeats the same text or the corrections are imprecise, a log of mistakes will only multiply the confusion. This is a development of the speaking trainer, not a promise to replace a teacher.
